# Gereh platform handbook

This handbook is the reference the support assistant answers from. Prices are in Toman.

## VPS

VPS is part of the Gereh platform. It is available in the Tehran and Frankfurt regions and is billed hourly, with a monthly cap.

### VPS limits

- Maximum instances per account: 5
- Default quota: 20 GB
- API rate limit: 60 requests per minute

### VPS pricing

| Plan | Monthly price | Hourly price |
|---|---|---|
| Small | 90000 | 125 |
| Medium | 180000 | 250 |
| Large | 360000 | 500 |

### VPS how-to

To get started, open the panel, choose the region, pick a plan and confirm. Provisioning usually finishes within a few minutes; you get an email when it is ready. To get started, open the panel, choose the region, pick a plan and confirm. Provisioning usually finishes within a few minutes; you get an email when it is ready. 

```bash
gereh vps create --region thr --plan small
```
